reports.title: Aya Gold & Silver Reports Strong Q3-2026 Results on Record Production and Lower Cash Costs Zgounder 2026 silver production guidance narrowed to 5.6–5.8 million ounces, raising the low end of the prior 5.2–5.8 million ounce range

lines: Aya Gold & Silver Reports Strong Q3-2026 Results on Record Production and Lower Cash Costs Zgounder 2026 silver production guidance narrowed to 5.6–5.8 million ounces, raising the low end of the prior 5.2–5.8 million ounce range

•Production guidance: Consolidated 2026 silver equivalent production is expected to be 6.6-6.8 million ounces ("Moz") including 5.6-5.8 Moz from Zgounder, with the low end raised compared to prior Zgounder guidance of 5.2-5.8 Moz3.
Full-year cash costs at the Zgounder Silver Mine are expected to remain below guidance of $21.50/oz.

On the strength of year-to-date performance, we are raising the low end of our 2026 production guidance at Zgounder to 5.6–5.8 million ounces of silver, up from 5.2–5.8 million ounces, and we are set for a strong finish to the year.”

The Company’s AgEq ounces for 2026 production guidance at Boumadine are calculated using an 80:1 Au:Ag ratio and assumed commodity prices of $50.00/oz silver and $4,000/oz gold, compared to an average realized ratio of approximately 68:1 during Q3-2026 and 64:1 year-to-date 2026.
3.2026 guidance assumes a silver price of $50.00/oz, a gold price of $4,000/oz, a USD/CAD exchange rate of 1.40 and a USD/MAD exchange rate of 9.00.
